next.description: URL or cursor for the next billing-cycle page returned by AutoPay.

previous.description: URL or cursor for the previous billing-cycle page returned by AutoPay.

scheduled_date.description: Date this billing period is or was scheduled to charge.

amount_due.description: Amount charged or attempted for this cycle.

status.description: Current billing cycle status, such as scheduled, processing, paid, retry_scheduled, failed, or canceled.

paid_at.description: Timestamp when this cycle was paid, or null if unpaid.

failure_reason.description: Gateway failure message from the last failed attempt, or null if not failed.

session_id.description: Connect session ID for the latest charge attempt, or null before any attempt.

charge_type.description: Charge type: cit, mit, or null before any attempt.

attempt_number.description: Attempt index starting at 1. Increments on each retry.

session_id.description: Connect session ID for this attempt.

result.description: Outcome of this attempt: success, failed, pending, or null before outcome is known.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when AutoPay initiated this payment attempt.

payment_attempts.description: All payment attempts for this billing cycle, oldest first.

results.description: Billing cycles in the current page.
